description: Multi-message thread: a meeting is proposed, then rescheduled by the other party. The latest message is the live obligation.

messages.raw:
From: Hospital Scheduling <scheduling@clinic.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: Your appointment on {{+6d}}
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:00:00 +0000
Message-ID: <appt-1@clinic.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

Your appointment is confirmed for {{+6d}} at 11:00 with Dr Almeida.

Please arrive ten minutes early and bring your referral letter.

Clinic Scheduling

From: Hospital Scheduling <scheduling@clinic.example>
To: demo@local.test
Re: Your appointment on {{+6d}}
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 15:40:00 +0000
In-Reply-To: <appt-1@clinic.example>
References: <appt-1@clinic.example>
Message-ID: <appt-2@clinic.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

Please note that your appointment has been rescheduled.

The previous slot on {{+6d}} at 11:00 is no longer available and your
appointment has been moved to {{+8d}} at 14:15 with Dr Almeida.

You must confirm the new appointment time by replying to this message. If you do
not confirm by {{+7d}} the new slot will be released and you will be placed
back on the waiting list, with a wait of several weeks.

Please bring your referral letter to the new appointment.

Clinic Scheduling
